work.title: Misters of the Word
work.description: Mixed-media collage featuring a vertical central panel with drawn sunglasses, a top-down warplane silhouette, and seven iridescent compact discs arranged around the figure. Handwritten reversed text reading "Misters of the Word" appears at left, with layered paper, ink marks, and green sculptural elements at lower center.
work.composition: vertical central panel flanked by orbiting discs
